identity_notes: No controlled human efficacy trial of horny goat weed / Epimedium for its marketed indications (libido, erectile function, testosterone, bone health) exists in this retrieved scope. The only genuine human interventional study (PMID 30522143) is a single-dose pharmacokinetic/safety trial with no efficacy endpoint. The remaining literature is dominated by: (1) case reports of adverse events (tachyarrhythmia/hypomania, mania, opioid-craving interaction with buprenorphine, rhabdomyolysis-type muscle toxicity, new-onset psychosis), and (2) systematic reviews of commercial multi-ingredient ED/testosterone supplements that name horny goat weed as a common ingredient but do not report ingredient-specific efficacy data in their abstracts. One retrieved record (icariin in ovariectomized rats, PMID 29208188) is an animal study and was rejected. Overall: efficacy evidence is essentially absent; safety-signal density (5 case reports across only 12 kept/screened records) is unusually high for this identity and should be weighted accordingly by the curator.
